Regarding the insider threat analysis, the primary risk factor is the recent resignation of the Research and Development team lead. Several indicators suggest potential malicious intent or negligence: multiple prototypes went missing, there were no signs of forced entry (suggesting authorized access was used), and the prototypes were last accounted for in his possession. Additionally, the unusual behavior of working late the week before his departure may indicate an attempt to conceal the removal of assets.
